tenderSchedule.title: Third party service for Development of Nuggikeri and tank rejuvenation works in Dharwad city inluding tank bund improvement, pitching, Compound wall, Entrance plaza, Utility complex, amphitheatre etc
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Third Party Quality Assurance (TPQA) Services including Independent Technical Supervision, Quality Assurance of all the items in BOQ ,Environmental Monitoring and Compliance Verification for the work of Development of Nuggikeri Tank and Rejuvenation Works in Dharwad City including Tank Bund Improvement, Stone Pitching, Compound Wall, Entrance Plaza, Utility Complex, Amphitheatre, Internal Roads, Walkways, Landscaping, Storm Water Drainage, Lighting, Water Supply, Sanitary Works and other allied civil, electrical, horticultural and public amenity works to independently verify that the construction materials and the completed works comply with the Specifications of IS MORTH IRC CPWD standards.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

As per Karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
It may be noted that the cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP.
The Employer reserves the right to reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons whatsoever.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Bidder can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Dharwad during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a holiday next working day will hold good in lieu of the dates mentioned.
Tender invited only for eligible Bidder/consultant should be registered with companies/empanelled in Karnataka PWD or any Karnataka Govt.

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2 : Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation.

The Rate quoted shall be include Remuneration for Key professional staff, Supporting Staff, Transportation, Duty Travel to Site, Office Rent, Office Supplies, Utilities and Communication, Office Furniture and Equipment, Reports and Document Printing, Surveys, all other taxes as applicable and other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work.
The Tenderer must submit Work Experience/3rd party work done documents duly attested by Gazzeted Officer and also produce original documents to the Executive Engineer for confirmation.
The tenderer shall note that rates quoted are exclusive of all taxes, GST etc., It may be noted that GST will be paid separately

THE BIDDERS/CONSULTANTS ARE INSTRUCTED TO SUBMIT ONLY RELEVENT INFORMATION WITH RECORDS AS REQUIRED AND SPECIFIED IN QUALIFICATION CRITERIA.ANY JUNK, SUPERFLOUS AND UNNECESARY DOCUMENTS IF UPLOADED WILL TREATED AS MISLEADING AND SUCH TENDERS ARE LIABLE TO BE REJECTED.

The turnover certificate shall invariably contain UDIN

If any, additional information required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Dharwad Division, Dharwad during of office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a General Holiday, the next working day will be considered

The Bidder shall not furnish any fake/fabricated/false information or withhold facts etc., if the bidder is found to have violated any of these above (found either during evaluation or after awarding the tender), the tender shall be rejected and action as per rules and regulations shall be taken against the Bidder
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, refectors,deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity.Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents K/C-7

Failure of successful consultant to compile with the requirements shall constitute sufficient grounds for cancellation of the awards forfeiture of the earnest money deposit asper prevailing Govt circular/Orders.

The EMD of Rs. 8950/- by e-payment in favour of Executive engineer, PWD Division Dharwad & Part(2) of the EMD.,Rs. 0.00/- by Bank Guarantee issued by Nationalized/Scheduled Bank.
